method: Read all current scanner implementation and focused tests, terminal component, focused tests and associated styles; reviewed R2-DEPLOY-002 and R2-DEPLOY-003 for adequacy. No historical checkout used.
Independently exercised every scanner rule with mixed odd/even/empty chunks, both UTF-16 byte orders and byte alignments, overlap turnover and byte/line accounting.

Loaded the actual current TerminalPanel, xterm 6.0.0, addon-fit 0.11.0 and application CSS through an ignored local Vite fixture with a simulated API. Inspected browser layout, terminal output and native dimension requests before and after repair.

scanner.conclusion: Both fixes cover the reported source/Git scanner omissions. No further scanner issue found in this focused review.

findings.summary: Padded fit host plus overflow clipping hides the final terminal row.
findings.reproduction: Actual TerminalPanel in a 500 x 490 CSS pixel container proposed rows=24 and cols=58. The surface ended at y=468, while the xterm grid ended at y=478.375: the last row was cropped by 10.375 pixels. Its right edge also exceeded the surface by 1 pixel.
findings.cause: FitAddon subtracts padding on the xterm element, but does not subtract padding on the parent used for measurement. The terminal-surface parent had 15px padding.
findings.fix: Retained the padded/background terminal-surface as an outer wrapper. Moved the terminal ref, xterm mount and ResizeObserver target to a new unpadded terminal-mount child with height:100%, min-height:0 and min-width:0. Existing 1..500 dimension clamping remains unchanged.

review: The ref and observer now measure the same unpadded element that directly contains xterm. Height responds to parent flex layout and narrowing does not increase panel width.
Open and live resize keep the rendered grid and native request dimensions synchronized; existing large-dimension and invalid-proposal tests pass.

During a blurred live shrink, xterm can retain off-screen helper-textarea coordinates in its internal scroll extent. The outer surface clips those helpers; the visible grid and panel remain within bounds. No terminal output is clipped.
limits: This focused review and subsequent authorized repair is not a formal independent clean audit round.
Browser API and terminal output were simulated locally; no actual shell, remote host, commercial model, external MCP or full test suite was used.
The 21 scanner unit tests reported by root were reviewed but not rerun here; independent scanner probes were executed instead.
Hashes represent this repair snapshot before planned repository-wide text newline normalization.
